name: forwardfig
description: Draw ML architecture figures in TypeScript, written the way you write the model. Zero dependencies, SVG out.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --minify --outfile dist/forwardfig.js && bun build src/index.ts --minify --format=iife --outfile dist/forwardfig.iife.js && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun test && bun run build
